prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1450; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle was struck on the front driver-side corner while turning left. The damage is visible on the bumper cover, the front fender, and the headlamp assembly, with a cracked reinforcement bar noted under the cover. Some of the lower-panel scuffing could have come from this impact or from an older event, and that cannot be settled from the photos alone. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. The proposed repair plan replaces the bumper cover, fender, and headlamp, and repairs the reinforcement bar, with labor hours that fit the damage described. The billing shows no repeated charges, and the parts list matches the work written up.
